scope: Targeted review of handoff WIP correctness gates; no fresh GPU timing, CPU parity run, soundness proof or end-to-end proof acceptance

gkr_benchmark.verdict: Do not accept benchmark success as correctness qualification or schedule outer GKR from this receipt

findings.issue: CPU transcript parity is computed into local eq and printed but does not affect the exit condition. With --cpu-ref, a mismatch can exit zero if verifier is skipped and source/status/stability checks pass.
findings.required_fix: Make requested CPU parity mandatory in the exit condition and add a deliberately corrupted transcript regression.

findings.issue: Verification defaults to skipped with ok=true. The preserved single-repetition receipt has verify.why=skipped and cpu_ref=null; stable output is repeatability, not mathematical correctness.
findings.required_fix: Represent skipped verification explicitly and require an executed independent verification plus CPU transcript parity before accepting kernel correctness.

gkr_benchmark.receipt_boundary: The 0.7616 ns/fact, 32.15 B/fact result is inherited one-repetition dev-5090 synthetic timing only. No new timing or main-pod native production claim. Existing kill threshold remains unsatisfied; do not spend main-pod GPU time reoptimizing this lever.

proof_parameters.verdict: Model/census prototype only; parameter promotion not accepted

findings.issue: The per-cap census records and continues on any graph construction error. Only cap0 and cap3 are asserted successful; cap2, cap4 and cap5 may hide unrelated implementation failures as unavailable census points.
findings.required_fix: Continue only on the specifically admitted cap-coverage failure and propagate all other errors; require success for intended proof-derivable cap2.

findings.issue: cap_failure is a union-bound estimate under a query distribution assumption. A bound above the admission threshold does not establish actual failure probability; a small modeled bound does not replace proof-format and implementation completeness validation.
findings.required_fix: Label the field and output as an upper bound under stated assumptions; gate caps/profile changes with full current producer, receiver, corpus and basket evidence.

positive_static_observations: Explicit optional cap_log distinguishes zero override from environment default.
Capped tape construction fails closed because the tape key omits cap shape.
Updated model includes exponential selectHash side cost and cap coverage, correcting the earlier larger-cap recommendation.
unrun: Fresh census at cap0/2/3 with intended environment overrides
Fresh full proof/receiver and negative corpus for any changed parameter profile
Reproduction of the model fit and security argument with producer-exported caps where required

claim_boundary: This closes the targeted review disposition as rejected for qualification; it does not qualify or land either prototype.
